newsitem.title: USA: America West expands Ohio non-stop service.
newsitem.headline: America West expands Ohio non-stop service.

text.p: America West Airlines said Thursday it would expand nonstop service from its Columbus hub to four new cities.
The cities include San Francisco and three in Florida: Miami, Fort Lauderdale and West Palm Beach.
The expansion increases direct nonstop service served by America West Airlines in Port Columbus International Airport to 17 destinations, the company said in a statement.
American West Airlines is a regional air carrier operating mostly in the southwestern and western states.
